            center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2

            print(f"Green block at ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)}), center=({center_r},{center_c})")
            # Try MOUSE on the green block
            result2 = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
            print(f"MOUSE on green: done={result2.get('done')}, gameplay_changed={result2.get('gameplay_changed')}")
